results.name: SQL Injection in User Query Handler

findings.title: CWE-89: Potential SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: Direct string interpolation of untrusted parameters into SQL queries leads to severe SQL injection vulnerabilities.
findings.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements via database driver bindings.
findings.refactoredSnippet:
const query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1";
const result = await db.query(query, [id]);

summary.reasoning: Critical security vulnerabilities identified that must be resolved prior to merging.

findings.title: Algorithmic Inefficiency: Nested Loop O(N^2) Scanning
findings.description: Nested loops iterating across collections scale quadratically. Converting the inner scan to a hash Set yields O(N) complexity.
findings.suggestion: Pre-index the second collection in a Set or Map for constant-time lookups.
findings.refactoredSnippet:
const setB = new Set(listB);
return listA.filter(item => setB.has(item));

findings.title: Unhandled Promise Rejection in Async Database Operation
findings.description: Awaiting database promises without a surrounding try/catch block will throw unhandled rejections during connectivity or query errors.
findings.suggestion: Wrap asynchronous operations inside structured try/catch blocks with error logging.

findings.title: CWE-798: Hardcoded High-Entropy Secret Credential
findings.description: Hardcoded secret token detected in source code. This exposes cryptographic tokens to repository exposure.
findings.suggestion: Externalize sensitive credentials into environment variables managed securely.
findings.refactoredSnippet:
const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
if (!JWT_SECRET) throw new Error("JWT_SECRET env var required");

findings.title: React Anti-Pattern: useEffect Lacking Dependency Array
findings.description: Omitting the second dependency array argument causes the effect to run on every render, triggering infinite re-render loops when state updates.
findings.suggestion: Provide an explicit dependency array including referenced props and state variables.

findings.title: Off-By-One Index Error: Accessing arr[arr.length]
findings.description: Zero-indexed arrays have elements from 0 to length - 1. Accessing index arr.length results in `undefined`.
findings.suggestion: Access the last element via arr[arr.length - 1] or arr.at(-1).
